demonstration.narration: I'll click the region that stands out in its panel, so the other panels show which service it affects.
demonstration.reasoning: A total across regions can hide that one region carries the failures. Clicking it filters every panel to that region, without editing the dashboard.
demonstration.evidence: Every panel now filters to ${var.value}, the region that stood out, and the service panel shows ${truth.scope} carrying its failures. Check the records behind the chart next.
